# Data Loading and Filtering

```{r Load Data}
#read in count data ----
data <- read.delim("rsem.merged.gene_counts.annot.tsv", 
                   row.names = NULL)

# Deal with genes that don't have annotated gene symbols (external_gene_name)
# Use ENSEMBL ID if gene symbol not available
data$external_gene_name <- ifelse(data$external_gene_name == ".",
  data$gene_id,
  data$external_gene_name
)

# Deal with duplicated gene symbols
# Combine gene symbol with ENSEMBL ID if non-unique
data$external_gene_name <- ifelse(duplicated(data$external_gene_name),
  paste(data$external_gene_name, data$gene_id, sep="_"),
  data$external_gene_name
)

# Then we can use the gene symbol column as the row names,
# and subset the count data for further analysis
rownames(data) <- data$external_gene_name
count.data <- data[,6:ncol(data)] # All columns after 5 are count data
gene_info = data[,1:5] # Columns with gene names and description 

#just leave number in sample name 
#colnames(count.data) <- sub("X15680.RP.", "", colnames(count.data))

#sample information
#read information about samples provided by AGC
info_file1= read.csv('DemuxStats_15680-RP.csv', 
                     check.names=FALSE,header=T, sep=",")

# Created a new column to match column names in raw data
info_file1$Sample_name = make.names(info_file1$Sample_ID)

# Verify that the order of count.data matches info_file1
info_file1$Sample_name == colnames(count.data)
sum(info_file1$Sample_name == colnames(count.data)) # ensure all 64 samples are true

# Rename the columns of count.data to be my naming convention
colnames(count.data) = info_file1$Description

```

```{r Filter Samples}
data_filt <- count.data[rowSums(count.data)>0,] # Remove 0 expression genes

#Remove genes Gm- or -Rik or -ps or ENSMUS-
data_filt1 = data_filt[!grepl("^Gm|Rik$|Rik[0-9]+$|-ps[0-9]+$|-ps$|^ENSMUS", rownames(data_filt)),] 

# Remove low expression genes
filt_low <- 10
keep1 <- rowSums(data_filt1) > (filt_low * 26) # Low count filter, required
data_filt1 <- data_filt1[keep1,] # Apply filter to counts data
dim(data_filt1) # Dimensions after applying low filter

```

# UT D18 NS vs UT D18 S Comparison

```{r UT D18 NS vs UT D18 S}
# Create a new column in the DESeq2 output that contains the EntrezIDs
UT_D18_dds_res <- res_df # make a copy of the DESeq2 results
UT_D18_dds_res$entrezID <- gene_info$entrezgene_id[
    match(rownames(UT_D18_dds_res), gene_info$external_gene_name)]

# Remove EntrezIDs that are just . or have multiple listed
UT_D18_dds_res <- UT_D18_dds_res[!UT_D18_dds_res$entrezID == ".", ]
UT_D18_dds_res <- UT_D18_dds_res[!grepl(",", UT_D18_dds_res$entrezID), ]

# Create the gene list for gseKEGG()
UT_D18_geneList <- UT_D18_dds_res$stat
names(UT_D18_geneList) <- UT_D18_dds_res$entrezID

UT_D18_geneList <- sort(UT_D18_geneList, decreasing = TRUE)

# Perform gseKEGG
UT_D18_kegg <- gseKEGG(
    geneList = UT_D18_geneList,
    organism = "mmu",
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    verbose  = FALSE)

# Visualize gseKEGG results
head(UT_D18_kegg)
View(as.data.frame(UT_D18_kegg))

dotplot(UT_D18_kegg, x = "NES", color = "p.adjust", size = "GeneRatio", 
        orderBy = "NES", showCategory = 30, label_format = 60, font.size = 18) + 
  labs( title = "KEGG GSEA UT D18") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 1) +
  theme(title = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.title.position = "panel") +
  theme_prism(base_line_size = 1)

# Perform gseGO
UT_D18_GO <- gseGO(
    geneList = UT_D18_geneList,
    OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
    keyType = "ENTREZID",
    ont = "BP",
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05
)

UT_D18_GO <- simplify(UT_D18_GO, cutoff = 0.5)

UT_D18_GO_df <- as.data.frame(UT_D18_GO)

UT_D18_GO_df <- subset(UT_D18_GO_df, p.adjust < 0.05 & abs(NES) > 1.5)

# Visualize gseGO results
dotplot(UT_D18_GO, 
        showCategory = 15) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))
       # split = ".sign") + 
  # ggplot2::facet_grid(. ~ .sign) 

UT_D18_GO_enrich <- pairwise_termsim(UT_D18_GO)
emapplot(UT_D18_GO_enrich)

gseaplot2(UT_D18_GO_enrich, geneSetID = 1)
        
ridgeplot(UT_D18_GO)


UT_D18_GO_NES <- UT_D18_GO_df %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(NES)))

ggplot(UT_D18_GO_NES[1:30, ],
       aes(x = NES,
           y = reorder(Description,NES))) +
  geom_point(aes(size = setSize,
                 color = -log10(p.adjust))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2)

```

## GO Pathway/Gene Identification

```{r UT D18 GO Pathways}
UT_D18_GO_df <- as.data.frame(setReadable(UT_D18_GO, OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID"))
UT_D18_GO_df <- subset(UT_D18_GO_df, p.adjust < 0.05 & abs(NES) > 1.5)

# Function for identifying matches in the pathway names or the leading edge genes
getMatches <- function(keywords, dataframe, target) {
  if (target == "pathways") {
    # Filter using grep or grepl (case-insensitive)
    result <- dataframe[grepl(paste(keywords, collapse = "|"), 
                                  dataframe$Description, 
                                  ignore.case = TRUE), ]
  }
  else if (target == "genes") {
    result <- dataframe[grepl(paste(keywords, collapse = "|"), 
                                  dataframe$core_enrichment, 
                                  ignore.case = TRUE), ]
  }
  return(result)
}

# Antigen presentation pathways
UT_D18_agpres_pathways <- getMatches(c("antigen", "MHC", "major", "HLA", 
                                       "histocompat", "cross presentation", 
                                       "immunoproteasome", "TAP", "peptide 
                                       loading","class I", "class II", "APM"), 
                                     UT_D18_GO_df, 
                                     "pathways")

# (moDC) effector cytokine release
UT_D18_eff_cyto <- getMatches(c("interleukin", "TNF", "tumor necrosis factor", 
                                "effector", "cytokine"),
                              UT_D18_GO_df,
                              "pathways")

# Adaptive immunity
UT_D18_lymphocyte_pathways <- getMatches(c("T cell", "lymphocyte", "B cell", 
                                           "NK cell", "natural", "adapti"), 
                                         UT_D18_GO_df,
                                         "pathways")

# Interferon responses
UT_D18_ifn_pathways <- getMatches(c("interferon", "IFN"), 
                                  UT_D18_GO_df,
                                  "pathways")

# Innate immunity
UT_D18_leuk_pathways <- getMatches(c("leukocyte", "neutrophil", "monocyte", 
                                     "macrophage", "innate", "immun", "myeloid", 
                                     "mononuc"), 
                                   UT_D18_GO_df, 
                                   "pathways")

# Immunosuppression
UT_D18_immunosupp_pathways <- getMatches(c("immunosupp", "downreg"), 
                                         UT_D18_GO_df, 
                                         "pathways") # 0 pathways!

# MDSC NETosis
UT_D18_netosis_genes <- getMatches(c("Pad", "Elane", "Mpo"),
                                    UT_D18_GO_df,
                                    "genes")

# MDSC immunosuppression
UT_D18_MDSCimmunosupp_genes <- getMatches(c("Il10", "Mmp", "iNOS", "nos", "nox", 
                                            "TGF", "Arg1", "Cd206", "Ym1"), 
                                 UT_D18_GO_df,
                                 "genes") 

# Neutrophil degranulation
UT_D18_degran_genes <- getMatches(c("Elane", "Ela", "Ltf", "Mmp9", "TNF", "Lyz", 
                                        "Mmp25", "uPAR", "Mmp13", "Lcn", "Ctsg", 
                                        "Prtn3"),
                                      UT_D18_GO_df,
                                      "genes")

# moMacs
UT_D18_moMac_genes <- getMatches(c("Trem2", "Spp1", "Folr2", "Opn"),
                                 UT_D18_GO_df,
                                 "genes")

# Anti-tumor cytokine production
UT_D18_cyto_genes <- getMatches(c("TNF", "Il1", "Ccl3", "Cxcl10"),
                                UT_D18_GO_df,
                                "genes")

# Hypoxia
UT_D18_hypoxia_genes <- getMatches(c("Hif", "Glut", "GYS1", "Adam12", "Lox"), 
                                   UT_D18_GO_df,
                                   "genes")

UT_D18_hypoxia_pathways <- getMatches(c("hypoxia", "oxygen"),
                                      UT_D18_GO_df,
                                      "pathways")

# Angiogenesis
UT_D18_angiogen_genes <- getMatches(c("Vegf", "Angpt", "Notch1", "Fscn2", "FGF", 
                                      "EGF", "PDGF"), 
                                    UT_D18_GO_df,
                                    "genes") # heart/muscle related pathways

# Myelopoiesis
UT_D18_myelopoiesis_genes <- getMatches(c("Csf", "Cebp", "Atf3", "Stat3", "Ccr2"),
                                        UT_D18_GO_df,
                                        "genes")

# Eosinophil activity
UT_D18_eosin_pathways <- getMatches(c("eosin", "eotax"),
                                    UT_D18_GO_df,
                                    "pathways")

UT_D18_eosin_genes <- getMatches(c("Ccl11", "Ccl24", "Ccl26", "Epx", "Prg2", 
                                     "Ear", "Ccr3", "Il5ra", "Siglecf", "Gata1", 
                                     "Cebpa", "Spi1", "Ido", "TGFb"), 
                                   UT_D18_GO_df,
                                   "genes")

# Myofibrils/fibers
UT_D18_myo_pathways <- getMatches(c("myofibril", "fibril", "assembly", 
                                    "filament", "fiber"),
                                  UT_D18_GO_df,
                                  "pathways")

# General metabolism
UT_D18_metab_pathways <- getMatches(c("metabo", "anabo", "catabo", "biosyn"), 
                                    UT_D18_GO_df, 
                                    "pathways")

# Lipid metabolism and fatty acid accumulation
UT_D18_lipid_pathways <- getMatches(c("lipid", "fat", "adipo", "unsatur", 
                                      "satur", "cholesterol"),
                                    UT_D18_GO_df,
                                    "pathways")

UT_D18_lipid_genes <- getMatches(c("Ppar", "Srebp", "Lxr", "Fasn", "Acc", "Cpt1a", 
                                   "Acox", "Apo", "Aldoc", "Pcsk9"), 
                                 UT_D18_GO_df,
                                 "genes")

# Signature genes
UT_D18_sigGenes <- getMatches(c("Pwwp4b", "Myh7", "Ctla4", "Rnf17", "Cpn1", 
                                "Calca", "Slc39a4", "Tph1", "Rab11fip4os1", 
                                "Aicda", "Cldn23"), 
                              UT_D18_GO_df, 
                              "genes")

UT_D18_upreg_paths <- UT_D18_GO_df[UT_D18_GO_df$NES > 0, ]

```

Antigen presentation, lymphocyte (T, B, NK cell) activity, interferon responses, 
and leukocyte processes are all downregulated in survivors. 

From general metabolism:
Metabolic processes are essentially the only upregulated pathways in survivors. 
The only downregulated metabolic processes in survivors relate to protein 
catabolism or "regulation of nitric oxide biosynthetic process".

Signature genes contribute in the leading edge of 6 pathways

```{r Dotplot of UT D18 Signature Gene Pathways}
ggplot(UT_D18_sigGenes,
       aes(x = NES,
           y = reorder(Description,NES))) +
  geom_point(aes(size = setSize,
                 color = -log10(p.adjust))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2)

```

```{r UT S D18 vs UT NS D18 Hallmarks GSEA}
# Set the Hallmark ontology
hallmark <- msigdbr(
    species = "Mus musculus",
    collection = "H")

# Create a list of genes in each gene set
hallmark_list <- data.frame(
    term = as.character(hallmark$gs_name),
    gene = as.character(hallmark$ncbi_gene),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

hallmark_list <- hallmark_list[
    !is.na(hallmark_list$term) &
    !is.na(hallmark_list$gene) &
    hallmark_list$term != "NA",]

UT_D18_geneList <- UT_D18_geneList[!is.na(names(UT_D18_geneList))]

# Perform the GSEA 
UT_D18_HM <- GSEA(
    geneList     = UT_D18_geneList,
    TERM2GENE    = hallmark_list,
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    verbose      = FALSE)

# Visualize!
UT_D18_HM_df <- as.data.frame(UT_D18_HM)

UT_D18_HM_NES <- UT_D18_HM_df %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(NES)))

ggplot(UT_D18_HM_NES[1:15, ],
       aes(x = NES,
           y = reorder(Description,NES))) +
  geom_point(aes(size = setSize,
                 color = -log10(p.adjust))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2)

```

11 pathways associated with angiogenesis genes. 10/11 downregulated in survivors

Most upregulated pathways are related to mitosis/fibril organization or molecule
transport, suggesting that the scaffold is experiencing tissue remodeling and 
normal FBR, rather than dysregulated immune signaling. 
[I wonder how UT | NPs would turn out?]

IFN responses and leukocyte regulation are downregulated in survivors.

7/8 metabolism pathways are downregulated in survivors, suggesting that an 
over-active system is detrimental for NP efficacy?? 
Genes related to lipid metabolism are all in downregulated pathways (n=17). 

Pathways associated with neutrophil-mediated immunosuppression are largely
downregulated in survivors (12/14 downregulated)

Signature genes:
Found in 6 pathways, all downregulated:
- 2 immune (response to virus, toxic substance)
- 3 energetics (insulin, NAD+, ion membrane transport)
  - Insulin and ion pathways: Suggests dampened immune responses?
  - All suggest a switch to oxidative phosphorylation?
  - Taken together: Resting cells are ideal for NP treatment; lack of exhaustion
  but rather waiting on external stimuli to induce immune responses
- 1 angiogenesis

# T W2 NS vs T W4 NS

## DESeq2

```{r T W2 NS vs T W4 NS DESeq2}
# Subset T NS samples from W2 and W4
T_NS_post <- data_filt1 %>% dplyr::select(matches("^T_NS.*_W(2|4)"))
T_NS_post <- round(T_NS_post, 0) # Make all counts integers

# Second dataframe with the timepoint for each sample
T_NS_post_coldata <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(T_NS_post), 
                      timepoint = ifelse(grepl("T_NS.*_W2", colnames(T_NS_post)), "W2", "W4"))

# Set the timepoint as a factor (a datatype) and list W2 first so it's the baseline comparison, which is more intuitive
T_NS_post_coldata$timepoint <- factor(T_NS_post_coldata$timepoint, levels = c("W2", "W4"))

T_NS_post_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = T_NS_post,
  colData = T_NS_post_coldata,
  design = ~ timepoint
)

T_NS_post_dds <- T_NS_post_dds[rowSums(counts(T_NS_post_dds)) > 10, ]

T_NS_post_dds <- DESeq(T_NS_post_dds)

resultsNames(T_NS_post_dds)
T_NS_post_res <- results(T_NS_post_dds, pAdjustMethod = "none")

summary(T_NS_post_dds)

# Order by adjusted p-value, which is the same as the p-value if the pAdjustMethod = none above
T_NS_post_res_ordered <- T_NS_post_res[order(T_NS_post_res$padj), ]
view(T_NS_post_res_ordered %>% data.frame())

# Shrink log2FC
# resLFC <- lfcShrink(dds, coef="condition_S_vs_NS", type="apeglm")

# Visualize!
T_NS_post_df <- as.data.frame(T_NS_post_res)

ggplot(T_NS_post_df, aes(x=log2FoldChange, y=-log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.5) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -1) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1) 

LFc = 1 #logfold change cutoff for DEGs
pc = 0.05 #pvalue cutoff for DEGs

```

## GSEA - KEGG and GO Ontologies

```{r T NS W2 vs T NS W4 KEGG and GO GSEA}
# Create a new column in the DESeq2 output that contains the EntrezIDs
T_NS_post_res$entrezID <- gene_info$entrezgene_id[
    match(rownames(T_NS_post_res), gene_info$external_gene_name)]

# Remove EntrezIDs that are just . or have multiple listed
T_NS_post_res <- T_NS_post_res[!T_NS_post_res$entrezID == ".", ]
T_NS_post_res <- T_NS_post_res[!grepl(",", T_NS_post_res$entrezID), ]

# Create the gene list for gseKEGG()
T_NS_post_geneList <- T_NS_post_res$stat
names(T_NS_post_geneList) <- T_NS_post_res$entrezID

T_NS_post_geneList <- sort(T_NS_post_geneList, decreasing = TRUE)

# Perform gseKEGG
T_NS_post_kegg <- gseKEGG(
    geneList = T_NS_post_geneList,
    organism = "mmu",
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    verbose  = FALSE)

# Visualize gseKEGG results
head(T_NS_post_kegg)
View(as.data.frame(T_NS_post_kegg))

dotplot(T_NS_post_kegg, x = "NES", color = "p.adjust", size = "GeneRatio", 
        orderBy = "NES", showCategory = 30, label_format = 60, font.size = 18) + 
  labs( title = "KEGG GSEA T NS W2 vs T NS W4") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 1) +
  theme(title = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.title.position = "panel") +
  theme_prism(base_line_size = 1)

# Perform gseGO
T_NS_post_GO <- gseGO(
    geneList = T_NS_post_geneList,
    OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
    keyType = "ENTREZID",
    ont = "BP",
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05
)

T_NS_post_GO <- simplify(T_NS_post_GO, cutoff = 0.5)

T_NS_post_GO_df <- as.data.frame(T_NS_post_GO)

T_NS_post_GO_df <- subset(T_NS_post_GO_df, p.adjust < 0.05 & abs(NES) > 1.5)

# Visualize gseGO results
dotplot(T_NS_post_GO, 
        showCategory = 15) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))
       # split = ".sign") + 
  # ggplot2::facet_grid(. ~ .sign) 

# UT_D18_GO_enrich <- pairwise_termsim(UT_D18_GO)
# emapplot(UT_D18_GO_enrich)

# gseaplot2(UT_D18_GO_enrich, geneSetID = 1)
        
# ridgeplot(UT_D18_GO)


T_NS_post_GO_NES <- T_NS_post_GO_df %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(NES)))

ggplot(T_NS_post_GO_NES[1:30, ],
       aes(x = NES,
           y = reorder(Description,NES))) +
  geom_point(aes(size = setSize,
                 color = -log10(p.adjust))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2)

```

Angiogenesis genes showed up in the leading edge of 5 pathways, 3 of which had
upregulated NES from W2 to W4. 

Metabolic pathways were all downregulated, suggesting a lowered capacity for 
clearing debris/response to stimuli?

Genes related to MDSC immunosuppression showed up in the leading edge of 5 
pathways, 3 of which had downregulated NES from W2 to W4 and were related to 
metabolism. 

Genes related to myelopoiesis showed up in the leading edge of 4 pathways, 3 of 
which had upregulated NES from W2 to W4. The only downregulated pathway was
"membraneless organelle assembly", perhaps reflecting hindered metabolism? 

Genes related to NETosis in 2 pathways, both upregulated. 

IFN-related pathways and genes showed up in 1 pathway ("response to IFNb"),
which was downregulated. 

Mitosis pathways showed general downregulation (n=3) with one upregulated pathway
("transcription initiation-coupled chromatin remodeling").

## GSEA - Hallmarks MSigDB

# Set the Hallmark ontology
hallmark <- msigdbr(
    species = "Mus musculus",

    term = as.character(hallmark$gs_name),
    gene = as.character(hallmark$ncbi_gene),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

hallmark_list <- hallmark_list[
    !is.na(hallmark_list$term) &
    !is.na(hallmark_list$gene) &
    hallmark_list$term != "NA",]

T_NS_post_geneList <- T_NS_post_geneList[!is.na(names(T_NS_post_geneList))]

# Perform the GSEA

    geneList     = T_NS_post_geneList,

    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,

```{r T S D18 vs T S W2 DESeq2}
# Subset T NS samples from D18 and W2
T_S_D18_W2 <- data_filt1 %>% dplyr::select(matches("^T_S.*_(D18|W2)"))
T_S_D18_W2 <- round(T_S_D18_W2, 0) # Make all counts integers

# Second dataframe with the timepoint for each sample
T_S_D18_W2_coldata <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(T_S_D18_W2), 
                      timepoint = ifelse(grepl("T_S.*_D18", colnames(T_S_D18_W2)), "D18", "W2"))

# Set the timepoint as a factor (a datatype) and list D18 first so it's the baseline comparison, which is more intuitive
T_S_D18_W2_coldata$timepoint <- factor(T_S_D18_W2_coldata$timepoint, levels = c("D18", "W2"))

T_S_D18_W2_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = T_S_D18_W2,
  colData = T_S_D18_W2_coldata,
  design = ~ timepoint
)

T_S_D18_W2_dds <- T_S_D18_W2_dds[rowSums(counts(T_S_D18_W2_dds)) > 10, ]

T_S_D18_W2_dds <- DESeq(T_S_D18_W2_dds)

resultsNames(T_S_D18_W2_dds)
T_S_D18_W2_res <- results(T_S_D18_W2_dds, pAdjustMethod = "none")

summary(T_S_D18_W2_dds)

# Order by adjusted p-value, which is the same as the p-value if the pAdjustMethod = none above
T_S_D18_W2_res_ordered <- T_S_D18_W2_res[order(T_S_D18_W2_res$padj), ]
view(T_S_D18_W2_res_ordered %>% data.frame())

# Shrink log2FC
# resLFC <- lfcShrink(dds, coef="condition_S_vs_NS", type="apeglm")

# Visualize!
T_S_D18_W2_df <- as.data.frame(T_S_D18_W2_res)

ggplot(T_S_D18_W2_df, aes(x=log2FoldChange, y=-log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.5) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -1) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1) 

LFc = 1 #logfold change cutoff for DEGs
pc = 0.05 #pvalue cutoff for DEGs

```

# Create a new column in the DESeq2 output that contains the EntrezIDs

# T S D18 vs T S W4

## DESeq2

```{r T S D18 vs T S W4 DESeq2}
# Subset T S samples from D18 and W4
T_S_D18_W4 <- data_filt1 %>% dplyr::select(matches("^T_S.*_(D18|W4)"))
T_S_D18_W4 <- round(T_S_D18_W4, 0) # Make all counts integers

# Second dataframe with the timepoint for each sample
T_S_D18_W4_coldata <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(T_S_D18_W4), 
                      timepoint = ifelse(grepl("T_S.*_D18", colnames(T_S_D18_W4)), "D18", "W4"))

# Set the timepoint as a factor (a datatype) and list D18 first so it's the baseline comparison, which is more intuitive
T_S_D18_W4_coldata$timepoint <- factor(T_S_D18_W4_coldata$timepoint, levels = c("D18", "W4"))

T_S_D18_W4_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = T_S_D18_W4,
  colData = T_S_D18_W4_coldata,
  design = ~ timepoint
)

T_S_D18_W4_dds <- T_S_D18_W4_dds[rowSums(counts(T_S_D18_W4_dds)) > 10, ]

T_S_D18_W4_dds <- DESeq(T_S_D18_W4_dds)

T_S_D18_W4_res <- results(T_S_D18_W4_dds, pAdjustMethod = "none")

# Visualize!
T_S_D18_W4_df <- as.data.frame(T_S_D18_W4_res)

ggplot(T_S_D18_W4_df, aes(x=log2FoldChange, y=-log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.5) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -1) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1) 

LFc = 1 #logfold change cutoff for DEGs
pc = 0.05 #pvalue cutoff for DEGs

```

## GSEA - KEGG Ontology

``` {r T S D18 vs T S W4 KEGG GSEA}
# Create a new column in the DESeq2 output that contains the EntrezIDs
T_S_D18_W4_res$entrezID <- gene_info$entrezgene_id[
    match(rownames(T_S_D18_W4_res), gene_info$external_gene_name)]

# Remove EntrezIDs that are just . or have multiple listed
T_S_D18_W4_res <- T_S_D18_W4_res[!T_S_D18_W4_res$entrezID == ".", ]
T_S_D18_W4_res <- T_S_D18_W4_res[!grepl(",", T_S_D18_W4_res$entrezID), ]

# Create the gene list for gseKEGG()
T_S_D18_W4_geneList <- T_S_D18_W4_res$stat
names(T_S_D18_W4_geneList) <- T_S_D18_W4_res$entrezID

T_S_D18_W4_geneList <- sort(T_S_D18_W4_geneList, decreasing = TRUE)

# Perform gseKEGG
T_S_D18_W4_kegg <- gseKEGG(
    geneList = T_S_D18_W4_geneList,
    organism = "mmu",
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    verbose  = FALSE)

# Visualize gseKEGG results
dotplot(T_S_D18_W4_kegg, x = "NES", color = "p.adjust", size = "GeneRatio", 
        orderBy = "NES", showCategory = 30, label_format = 60, font.size = 18) + 
  labs( title = "KEGG GSEA T S D18 vs T S W4") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 1) +
  theme(title = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.title.position = "panel") +
  theme_prism(base_line_size = 1)

```

## GSEA - GO Database

```{r T S D18 vs T S W4 GO GSEA}
# Perform gseGO
T_S_D18_W4_GO <- gseGO(
    geneList = T_S_D18_W4_geneList,
    OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
    keyType = "ENTREZID",
    ont = "BP",
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05
)

T_S_D18_W4_GO <- simplify(T_S_D18_W4_GO, cutoff = 0.7)

T_S_D18_W4_GO_df <- as.data.frame(T_S_D18_W4_GO)

T_S_D18_W4_GO_df <- subset(T_S_D18_W4_GO_df, p.adjust < 0.05 & abs(NES) > 1.5)

# Visualize gseGO results (defaults to GeneRatio)
dotplot(T_S_D18_W4_GO, 
        showCategory = 15) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))

# Visualize gseGO results with NES on x-axis (more intuitive)
T_S_D18_W4_GO_NES <- T_S_D18_W4_GO_df %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(NES)))

ggplot(T_S_D18_W4_GO_NES[1:30, ],
       aes(x = NES,
           y = reorder(Description,NES))) +
  geom_point(aes(size = setSize,
                 color = -log10(p.adjust))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2)

```
